mechanism: Both drugs increase cholinergic and noradrenergic activity respectively, with potential additive effects on heart rate, blood pressure, and CNS stimulation; atomoxetine is metabolized by CYP2D6 which donepezil may weakly inhibit.
action: Monitor heart rate, blood pressure, and cardiac rhythm; assess for excessive CNS stimulation or cholinergic effects; use combination cautiously in patients with cardiac conditions.
